bullets: Injury & Practice Status: New England opened G Alijah Vera-Tucker's 21-day IR practice window alongside limited work for FB Reggie Gilliam (knee) [Pro Football Rumors](https://www.profootballrumors.com/2026/11/patriots-designate-g-alijah-vera-tucker-for-return). QB Drake Maye (fibula), WR A.J. Brown (hamstring), OL Walter Rouse (concussion protocol), and CB Carlton Davis III (knee) did not practice Wednesday, while C Ben Brown (knee) practiced in full [Oliver Thomas](https://www.patspulpit.com/new-england-patriots-news/145201/patriots-vs-chargers-wednesday-injury-report-four-non-participants-carlton-davis-aj-brown).

Week 12 Chargers Outlook: Mike Vrabel and DC Zak Kuhr open installation for the Los Angeles Chargers (1-9, NE -1.5, HC Jim Harbaugh, OC Mike McDaniel & DC Chris O'Leary (Road Test)) as New England prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873093) [patriots.com Official](https://www.patriots.com/news/week-12-injury-report-patriots-at-chargers).

Around the Beat: Patriots rooting guide for Thanksgiving weekend [Bernd Buchmasser](https://www.patspulpit.com/new-england-patriots-opinion/145243/patriots-rooting-guide-nfl-week-12-thanksgiving).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, New England ranks #17 in Points / Game (22.1), #19 in Points Allowed / Game (24.2), #31 in Turnover Differential (-10), giving Mike Vrabel and Zak Kuhr a clear benchmark ahead of Sun, Nov 29, 4:05 PM EST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Los Angeles Chargers [Marima](https://www.patspulpit.com/new-england-patriots-news/145136/patriots-news-pats-need-defense-in-top-form-to-tackle-chargers).
